description:
The customer support team needs a way to link official documentation on product pages. Your task is to add a 'User Manual' field to the product catalog and populate it for a specific product.

Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Default' product type configuration (Commerce > Configuration > Product types).
2. Add a new field of type 'Link'.
   - Label: 'User Manual'
   - Machine name: 'field_user_manual' (this usually auto-generates)
3. Configure the field settings to allow 'External links only' and set 'Link text' to 'Allowed'.
4. Go to the 'Manage display' tab for the Default product type.
   - Ensure the 'User Manual' field is enabled (not under Disabled/Hidden).
   - Set the Label display to 'Inline'.
5. Navigate to the Products list and edit the 'Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones'.
6. In the new 'User Manual' field, enter:
   - URL: https://www.sony.com/electronics/support/wireless-headphones-bluetooth-headphones/wh-1000xm5/manuals
   - Link text: Official PDF Manual
7. Save the product.
